subject: general
question: On which date is International Yoga day celebrated?
solution:
The correct answer is __**21st June**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• International Yoga Day is celebrated on **21st June** every year globally.
 
• The idea of International Yoga Day was first proposed by **India's Prime Minister Narendra Modi** during his speech at the United Nations General Assembly (UNGA) on 27th September 2014.
 
• The date, **21st June**, was chosen because it is the longest day of the year in the Northern Hemisphere and shares special significance in many parts of the world.
 
• International Yoga Day aims to raise awareness worldwide of the many benefits of practicing yoga.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Yoga**

 
 
• Yoga is a physical, mental, and spiritual practice that originated in ancient India.
 
• The word "Yoga" is derived from the Sanskrit root "Yuj," meaning "to join" or "to unite."
 
• Practicing yoga is believed to lead to the union of an individual's consciousness with the universal consciousness, indicating a perfect harmony between the mind and body, man and nature.
 
• There are various styles of yoga, including Hatha Yoga, Ashtanga Yoga, Vinyasa Yoga, and Kundalini Yoga, each focusing on different aspects of physical and mental well-being.
 
 
 
• **United Nations General Assembly (UNGA)**
 
 
• The UNGA is one of the six principal organs of the United Nations (UN) and the only one in which all member nations have equal representation.
 
• Its powers are to oversee the budget of the United Nations, appoint the non-permanent members to the Security Council, receive reports from other parts of the United Nations, and make recommendations in the form of General Assembly Resolutions.
 
• It meets under its president or the UN Secretary-General in regular yearly sessions and special sessions.
 
• The first session was convened on 10 January 1946 in the Westminster Central Hall in London and included representatives of 51 nations.
 
 
 
• **Benefits of Yoga**
 
 
• Yoga helps in improving flexibility, strength, and balance.
 
• It promotes better breathing, reduces stress, and enhances mental clarity and calmness.
 
• Regular practice of yoga can improve cardiovascular and circulatory health.
 
• Yoga has also been shown to alleviate chronic pain, improve sleep, and boost overall well-being.
 
 
 
• **Global Participation**
 
 
• International Yoga Day has seen widespread participation globally, with millions of people taking part in yoga sessions organized in various countries.
 
• Events are held in schools, colleges, community centers, parks, and even in large public squares.
 
• Governments, non-profit organizations, and yoga institutions collaborate to organize yoga sessions, workshops, and seminars to promote the practice of yoga.
 
• The day is also marked by speeches, discussions, and cultural performances that highlight the importance and benefits of yoga.
